# Aptos Labs on GitHub Pages

> Landing for documentation hosted directly from Aptos Labs source repositories. The canonical Aptos developer site is at https://aptos.dev.

## Documentation

- [Move on Aptos Book](https://aptos-labs.github.io/move-book/): Reference for the Move language as used on Aptos, including the Move Specification Language and Move Prover.

## External

- [Aptos developer documentation](https://aptos.dev): Full developer site (canonical).
- [Aptos Labs on GitHub](https://github.com/aptos-labs): Source repositories.
